# Find 3x3 hollow squares with center 2
def find_square_centers(g):
    centers = []
    for r in range(rows-2):
        for c in range(cols-2):
            if (g[r][c] == 3 and g[r+2][c] == 3 and  # left
                g[r][c+2] == 3 and g[r+2][c+2] == 3 and  # right
                g[r][c+1] == 3 and g[r+2][c+1] == 3 and  # top & bottom
                g[r+1][c+1] == 2):  # center
                centers.append((r+1, c+1))
    return centers

centers = find_square_centers(grid)

vert_mirrors = set(c for c in range(cols) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(rows)))
horiz_mirrors = set(r for r in range(rows) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(cols)))

print(f"Horizontal mirrors (rows with full 2s): {sorted(horiz_mirrors)}")

# For each center, create vertical and horizontal passes of 1s
for r, c in centers:
    # Vertical pass at column c - extends full height, stops at mirrors
    for row in range(rows):
        if grid[row][c] == 0:
            grid[row][c] = 1
    
    # Horizontal pass at row r - extends full width, stops at mirrors  
    for col in range(cols):
        if grid[r][col] == 0:
            grid[r][col] = 1

print("\nResult:")

    print(' '.join(str(x) for x in row))
